search_text: published ZDI-21-1376 ZDI-CAN-14377 Bitdefender GravityZone Unnecessary Privileges Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability 2021-12-03 CVE-2021-3576 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2021-3576 7.0 AV:L/AC:H/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Bitdefender'] ['GravityZone'] This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of Bitdefender GravityZone. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the endpoint client. The issue results from allowing an untrusted process to impersonate the client of a pipe. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of SYSTEM. Bitdefender has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. title: Bitdefender GravityZone Unnecessary Privileges Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of Bitdefender GravityZone. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the endpoint client. The issue results from allowing an untrusted process to impersonate the client of a pipe. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of SYSTEM.
